explication: StarRocks is a distributed SQL analytics engine with a Java frontend and C++ backends. The main workflow is a client submitting SQL, frontend resource admission, backend query setup and pipeline construction, then parallel execution and a result returned to the client. The README also describes vectorized SQL, lake queries, real-time updates, materialized views, and tenant resource controls; these are represented as product capabilities, though their implementation paths are not present in the supplied tree. Sampled source supports the queue, pipeline, executor, cache, spill, and load-spill details shown here; other links are limited to documented architecture.
